nodes.name: Reonic
nodes.notes: Energy management and building optimization.

nodes.name: Voize
nodes.notes: Voice AI for care documentation in healthcare.

nodes.name: Praxipal
nodes.notes: Digital health platform for practices and patients.

nodes.name: Dream Mobility
nodes.notes: Berlin-based mobility venture (dream Mobility GmbH) focused on passenger night-train and related mobility services. No public marketing website listed in lobby register (n/a); contact domain dreammobility.eu.

nodes.name: Mobility

nodes.name: Resilient Cities

nodes.name: Open Systems Lab
nodes.notes: Non-profit R&D lab redesigning societal operating systems (WikiHouse, PlanX, Fairhold, BuildX). See https://www.opensystemslab.io/about

nodes.name: Nature Wealth
nodes.notes: Non-profit foundation for high-integrity biodiversity credit development and nature finance strategies.

nodes.name: GovTech
nodes.notes: Digital government / public-sector technology domain.

nodes.name: Bureaucracy
nodes.notes: Administrative friction and legacy process in government.

nodes.name: Urban health
nodes.notes: Health outcomes shaped by cities, housing, mobility, and environment.

nodes.name: Wermuth Asset Management
nodes.notes: Impact / climate-aligned asset management.

nodes.name: Switchcoal
nodes.notes: Coal-to-clean / energy transition initiative.

nodes.name: Landbanking Group
nodes.notes: Land / nature-related asset approaches.

nodes.name: Biodiversity as an asset
nodes.notes: Treating biodiversity and ecosystems as investable / stewarded assets.

nodes.name: Biodiversity loss
nodes.notes: Collapse of ecosystems and species — linked to climate change.

nodes.name: Tactical Tech
nodes.notes: Berlin-based nonprofit exploring the social, political, and environmental impacts of technology. Climate & AI / information-and-climate workstream. Hiring: https://www.linkedin.com/company/tactical-tech/jobs/

nodes.name: Digital health
nodes.notes: Digital tools for care delivery, documentation, and patient access.

nodes.name: Nature finance
nodes.notes: Capital structures for nature and biodiversity — credits, stewardship, land value.

nodes.name: Climate finance
nodes.notes: Capital for the energy transition and climate-aligned assets.

nodes.name: Coal-to-clean
nodes.notes: Replacing coal generation with clean power and a just transition.

nodes.name: Climate information
nodes.notes: Public understanding of climate and the environmental impact of technology.

nodes.name: iRights.Lab
nodes.notes: Independent Berlin think tank at the intersection of law, technology, politics, and society. 35+ experts; digital policy, AI ethics & regulation, digital administration, literacy, open knowledge, democratic participation. Collaborated with CityLAB on Digital Vereint and shared stages on public-sector AI.

nodes.name: CityLAB Berlin
nodes.notes: Berlin's public innovation lab (Technologiestiftung Berlin; funded by Senate Chancellery). Prototypes digital admin & smart-city tools with citizens and administration — BärGPT, Parla, Kiezlabor, Gieß den Kiez. Co-authored Öffentliches Gestalten handbook with Politics for Tomorrow; partnered with iRights.Lab on Digital Vereint.

nodes.name: Politics for Tomorrow
nodes.notes: Non-partisan Berlin initiative (c/o nextlearning e.V.) building public-sector innovation capacity for human and planetary wellbeing. Public service design, cross-sector alliances, organizational learning. Co-created Öffentliches Gestalten with CityLAB; involved in Berlin Smart City / Gemeinsam Digital work.

nodes.name: A Color Bright
nodes.notes: Berlin brand and product design studio (founded 2013). Partners with startups to global consumer brands on brand development, UX/UI, and digital product discovery. info@acolorbright.com

nodes.name: Information Architects
nodes.notes: iA / Information Architects — design & software company (Zurich product team; Tokyo UXD for Japanese market). Focused writing and presentation tools (iA Writer, iA Presenter). ia@ia.net · ia.net

nodes.name: Zalando
nodes.notes: Europe's leading online fashion & lifestyle platform; founded Berlin 2008. Large product-design organization (platform, apps, enterprise tools).

nodes.name: Gnome
nodes.notes: Gnome is a free interface for linux

nodes.name: Ecoworks
nodes.notes: Serielle Fassaden-Sanierung

nodes.name: Design agencies
nodes.notes: Studios and agencies for product, brand, and invention design.

nodes.name: Special Projects
nodes.notes: London design and invention agency founded in 2014 by Clara Gaggero Westaway and Adrian Westaway. Research, creative technology, and product invention for companies such as Google, Samsung, BBC, LEGO, and Sonos. B Corp. Studio in Richmond, London.

nodes.name: Pilotfish
nodes.notes: Product design and hardware development agency (founded 2000). Industrial design, engineering, and manufacturing support for MedTech and technology products. Studios in Berlin, Amsterdam, Taipei, and Lisbon.

nodes.name: Thermondo
nodes.notes: Berlin-based heat-pump installer. Plans, funds, and installs heat pumps across Germany. Founded 2013. thermondo.de

nodes.name: Earth observation
nodes.notes: Satellite imagery and analytics for seeing environmental change — climate, land, infrastructure, and adaptation.

nodes.name: Planet Labs
nodes.notes: Planet Labs PBC. Daily satellite imagery and Earth-data analytics. Mission is to make global change visible, accessible, and actionable. planet.com

nodes.name: LiveEO
nodes.notes: Berlin Earth-observation company. Turns satellite imagery into risk intelligence for infrastructure and supply chains — vegetation, pipelines, and deforestation. Founded 2018. live-eo.com

nodes.name: Center for Humane Technology
nodes.notes: Nonprofit founded in 2018 by Tristan Harris, Aza Raskin, and Randima Fernando. Works on the harms of attention-economy platforms and misaligned AI, and on shifting technology toward the common good. humanetech.com

nodes.name: Geopolitical pressure
nodes.notes: Strategic dependence and security competition — pressure on European autonomy in technology, defense, and space.

nodes.name: Digital sovereignty
nodes.notes: Independent control over digital infrastructure, data, and technology — reducing dependence on non-European providers.

nodes.name: Defense
nodes.notes: Sovereign defense capability for a more contested security environment.

nodes.name: Space travel
nodes.notes: Independent access to space — launch, satellites, and strategic infrastructure.

nodes.name: AISI Deutschland
nodes.notes: AI Safety and Security Institute Deutschland. National institute, still being built, for evaluating capable AI systems and advising the federal government on AI security and digital sovereignty. Led by BMDS and BMI, with BSI (security) and BNetzA (safety) forming the first nucleus. Not a regulator. Planned seat in Berlin.

nodes.name: Helsing
nodes.notes: European defense AI company. Builds software for sensing, electronic warfare, and autonomous systems so democracies can defend themselves. Founded 2021. helsing.ai

nodes.name: Bauhaus Erde
nodes.notes: Nonprofit think-and-make tank for a regenerative built environment — bio-based materials, circular construction, and buildings and cities as carbon sinks. Also known as Bauhaus Earth. Founded 2019 by Hans Joachim Schellnhuber and Marc Weissgerber. Headquarters in Berlin, branch in Potsdam.

nodes.name: wernerundwalter
nodes.notes: Landscape architecture and product design studio for urban open space. Turns sealed surfaces into climate-resilient places and designs modular urban products. Founded 2025 by Niklas Werner and Richard Walter. Leipzig. wernerundwalter.de

nodes.name: Capacity.eco
nodes.notes: Nonprofit venture studio building moonshot missions to defend nature. Combines AI, satellite intelligence, and frontline partners. First mission, The Shield, protects the Amazon. Founded 2024. Headquarters in Zurich.

nodes.name: Blue Impact
nodes.notes: Evergreen impact fund backing pre-seed and seed climate and biodiversity teams. Profits are reinvested. Lawrence Leuschner pledged his TIER stake to the fund. Berlin.

nodes.name: Ecosia
nodes.notes: Search engine that puts ad profits into climate action — tree planting, ecosystem restoration, regenerative agriculture, and renewable energy. Steward-owned European alternative to big-tech search. Founded 2009 in Berlin.

nodes.name: Recovering nature
nodes.notes: Restoring ecosystems — forests, soils, and biodiversity — to draw down carbon and slow climate change.
